design: Each of eight fresh controller seeds plays each of two six-human-player SFT models at two exact native holds, 62 ms and 120 ms. Williams order is replicated twice, balancing every arm by period and every ordered pair of immediate predecessors. Original Normal TH10 trial, fresh stock, all four actions, no assistance, no Continue. No mid-hold images. Native RNG and incidental load uncontrolled.

motion_clock.source: Eight separate original TH10 credits. The native sensor samples about every 25ms. Select four consecutive stable same-life cardinal direction/focus readings in the playfield interior. Isolate movement on the commanded axis. At least one of the three adjacent displacements is positive. The two most frequent displacements identify one and two motion increments. Include zero-increment pairs where neighboring readings are moving. A per-credit rate needs at least five qualified sensor pairs. This estimates native active motion pacing, not a direct engine-clock register.
